PATH: ./src/components/ProductTabsSection.tsx

"use client";

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { MessageSquare, Star, Plus, Clock } from "lucide-react";
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent } from "./ui/tabs";
import { Button } from "./ui/button";
import CommentDialog from "./CommentDialog";

interface ProductTabsSectionProps {
  productId: string;
  description: string;
  initialComments: any[];
}

export default function ProductTabsSection({
  productId,
  description,
  initialComments,
}: ProductTabsSectionProps) {
  const [comments, setComments] = useState<any[]>(initialComments);
  const [isCommentDialogOpen, setIsCommentDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [replyParentId, setReplyParentId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleCommentSubmitted = (newComment: {
    first_name: string;
    comment_text: string;
    rating: number | null;
  }) => {
    const newLocalComment = {
      id: `local_new_${Date.now()}`,
      first_name: newComment.first_name,
      last_name: "",
      rating: newComment.rating,
      comment_text: newComment.comment_text,
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      is_pending: true,
      replies: [],
    };

    if (replyParentId) {
      setComments((prev) =>
        prev.map((c) => {
          if (c.id === replyParentId) {
            return {
              ...c,
              replies: [...(c.replies || []), newLocalComment],
            };
          }
          return c;
        }),
      );
    } else {
      setComments((prev) => [newLocalComment, ...prev]);
    }
  };

  const openNewCommentDialog = () => {
    setReplyParentId(null);
    setIsCommentDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const openReplyDialog = (parentId: string) => {
    setReplyParentId(parentId);
    setIsCommentDialogOpen(true);
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="mt-16 border-t border-stone-800/80 pt-10 text-right"
      dir="rtl"
    >
      <Tabs defaultValue="comments" className="flex flex-col w-full" dir="rtl">
        <TabsList
          className="bg-stone-900 border border-stone-800 p-1 mb-8 flex w-full max-w-md"
          dir="rtl"
        >
          <TabsTrigger
            value="comments"
            className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer py-2.5"
          >
            <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4" />
            نظرات مشتریان ({comments?.length || 0})
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger
            value="description"
            className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer py-2.5"
          >
            توضیحات تخصصی محصول
          </TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent
          value="comments"
          className="space-y-6 w-full text-right"
          dir="rtl"
        >
          <div
            className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between w-full"
            dir="rtl"
          >
            <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-stone-200">
              نظرات و پرسش‌های کاربران
            </h3>
            <Button
              onClick={openNewCommentDialog}
              className="bg-gold-500 hover:bg-gold-600 text-stone-950 font-bold cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4 ml-1.5" />
              ثبت دیدگاه جدید
            </Button>
          </div>

          {comments && comments.length > 0 ? (
            <div
              className="divide-y divide-stone-800/80 bg-stone-900/20 p-6 rounded-2xl border border-stone-900/60 text-right"
              dir="rtl"
            >
              {comments.map((comment: any) => (
                <CommentNode
                  key={comment.id}
                  comment={comment}
                  onReply={openReplyDialog}
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="text-center py-12 bg-stone-900/20 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-stone-800">
              <p className="text-sm text-stone-500">
                تاکنون دیدگاهی ثبت نشده است. اولین دیدگاه را شما ثبت کنید!
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent
          value="description"
          className="bg-stone-900/20 p-6 rounded-2xl border border-stone-900/60 text-stone-300 leading-relaxed text-sm w-full text-right"
          dir="rtl"
        >
          <p>{description || "توضیحات تکمیلی برای این محصول ثبت نشده است."}</p>
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>

      <CommentDialog
        isOpen={isCommentDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setIsCommentDialogOpen}
        productId={productId}
        replyParentId={replyParentId}
        onCommentSubmitted={handleCommentSubmitted}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

interface CommentNodeProps {
  comment: any;
  onReply: (parentId: string) => void;
}

function CommentNode({ comment, onReply }: CommentNodeProps) {
  return (
    <div className="py-5 space-y-3 text-right" dir="rtl">
      <div
        className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between w-full"
        dir="rtl"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5" dir="rtl">
          <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-stone-800 border border-stone-700/60 flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-black text-gold-500">
            {comment.first_name?.[0] || "ک"}
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col">
            <span className="font-bold text-stone-200 text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
              {comment.first_name} {comment.last_name}
              {comment.is_pending && (
                <span className="text-[10px] bg-gold-500/10 border border-gold-500/20 text-gold-500 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Clock className="w-3 h-3" /> در انتظار تایید
                </span>
              )}
            </span>
          </div>
          {comment.rating && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-gold-500/10 border border-gold-500/25 text-gold-500 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold">
              <Star className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-gold-500 text-gold-500" />
              <span>{comment.rating}</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <span className="text-xs text-stone-500">
          {new Date(comment.created_at).toLocaleDateString("fa-IR")}
        </span>
      </div>

      <p
        className="text-sm text-stone-300 pr-11 leading-relaxed text-right"
        dir="rtl"
      >
        {comment.comment_text}
      </p>

      <div className="pr-11">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onReply(comment.id)}
          className="text-xs text-gold-500 hover:text-gold-400 hover:underline transition-colors font-bold cursor-pointer"
        >
          پاسخ به این نظر
        </button>
      </div>

      {comment.replies && comment.replies.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mr-9 pr-4 border-r border-stone-800/80 space-y-3 mt-4">
          {comment.replies.map((reply: any) => (
            <CommentNode key={reply.id} comment={reply} onReply={onReply} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


----------------------------------------------------------------

================================================================
PATH: ./src/components/CommentDialog.tsx
================================================================

"use client";

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useForm, Controller } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { z } from "zod";
import { MessageSquare, Star, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "./ui/button";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "./ui/dialog";
import { submitCommentAction } from "@/app/actions/comment";

const commentSchema = z.object({
  firstName: z
    .string()
    .min(1, "لطفاً نام خود را وارد کنید")
    .min(2, "نام باید حداقل ۲ حرف باشد")
    .max(50, "نام بیش از حد طولانی است"),
  phone: z
    .string()
    .optional()
    .refine((val) => !val || /^09[0-9]{9}$/.test(val), {
      message: "لطفاً یک شماره موبایل معتبر (مانند ۰۹۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹) وارد کنید",
    }),
  rating: z.number().min(1).max(5).nullable().optional(),
  commentText: z
    .string()
    .min(1, "لطفاً متن دیدگاه خود را وارد کنید")
    .min(5, "دیدگاه باید حداقل ۵ کاراکتر باشد")
    .max(1000, "دیدگاه بیش از حد طولانی است"),
});

type CommentFormValues = z.infer<typeof commentSchema>;

interface CommentDialogProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  productId: string;
  replyParentId: string | null;
  onCommentSubmitted: (newComment: {
    first_name: string;
    comment_text: string;
    rating: number | null;
  }) => void;
}

export default function CommentDialog({
  isOpen,
  onOpenChange,
  productId,
  replyParentId,
  onCommentSubmitted,
}: CommentDialogProps) {
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [commentMessage, setCommentMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [commentError, setCommentError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const methods = useForm<CommentFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(commentSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      firstName: "",
      phone: "",
      rating: 5,
      commentText: "",
    },
    mode: "onTouched",
  });

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    control,
    reset,
    formState: { errors },
  } = methods;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) {
      reset();
      setCommentMessage(null);
      setCommentError(null);
    }
  }, [isOpen, reset]);

  const onSubmit = async (values: CommentFormValues) => {
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setCommentError(null);
    setCommentMessage(null);

    try {
      const result = await submitCommentAction({
        productId,
        phone: values.phone || null,
        firstName: values.firstName,
        commentText: values.commentText,
        rating: replyParentId ? null : (values.rating ?? 5),
        parentId: replyParentId,
      });

      if (result.success) {
        setCommentMessage(result.message || "دیدگاه شما ثبت گردید.");
        onCommentSubmitted({
          first_name: values.firstName,
          comment_text: values.commentText,
          rating: replyParentId ? null : (values.rating ?? 5),
        });
        reset();
      } else {
        setCommentError(result.error || "خطایی رخ داد.");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setCommentError("خطا در ارتباط با سیستم ثبت بازخورد.");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent
        dir="rtl"
        className="max-w-md bg-stone-900 border border-stone-800 text-stone-100 p-6 rounded-2xl text-right"
      >
        <DialogHeader className="space-y-2 text-right">
          <DialogTitle className="text-lg font-bold text-gold-500 flex items-center gap-2">
            <MessageSquare className="w-5 h-5" />
            {replyParentId ? "ثبت پاسخ به دیدگاه" : "ثبت دیدگاه جدید"}
          </DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription className="text-xs text-stone-400">
            دیدگاه‌ها پس از تایید مدیر بر روی وبسایت نمایش داده می‌شوند.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        {commentMessage ? (
          <div className="text-center py-6 space-y-4">
            <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto text-xl font-bold">
              ✓
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-400">
              {commentMessage}
            </p>
            <Button
              onClick={() => {
                onOpenChange(false);
                setCommentMessage(null);
              }}
              className="w-full bg-stone-800 hover:bg-stone-700 text-stone-100 font-bold py-2.5 rounded-xl cursor-pointer"
            >
              متوجه شدم
            </Button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form
            onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}
            className="space-y-4 mt-3"
            dir="rtl"
          >
            <div className="space-y-1.5 text-right">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-stone-300">
                نام شما <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                {...register("firstName")}
                className={`w-full bg-stone-950 border focus:ring-1 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm text-stone-100 outline-none transition-all text-right ${
                  errors.firstName
                    ? "border-destructive/60 focus:border-destructive focus:ring-destructive/30"
                    : "border-stone-800 focus:border-gold-500 focus:ring-gold-500"
                }`}
                placeholder="مثال: مریم"
              />
              {errors.firstName && (
                <p className="text-[10px] text-destructive font-bold mt-1">
                  {errors.firstName.message}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5 text-right">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-stone-300">
                شماره موبایل (اختیاری)
              </label>
              <input
                type="tel"
                {...register("phone")}
                className={`w-full bg-stone-950 border focus:ring-1 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm text-stone-100 outline-none transition-all text-left ${
                  errors.phone
                    ? "border-destructive/60 focus:border-destructive focus:ring-destructive/30"
                    : "border-stone-800 focus:border-gold-500 focus:ring-gold-500"
                }`}
                dir="ltr"
                placeholder="09123456789"
              />
              {errors.phone && (
                <p className="text-[10px] text-destructive font-bold mt-1">
                  {errors.phone.message}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>

            {!replyParentId && (
              <div className="space-y-1.5 text-right bg-stone-950/40 p-3 rounded-xl border border-stone-800/50">
                <label className="text-xs font-bold text-stone-300 block mb-1">
                  امتیاز شما به کیفیت قهوه:
                </label>
                <Controller
                  name="rating"
                  control={control}
                  render={({ field: { value, onChange } }) => (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((star) => (
                        <button
                          key={star}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => onChange(star)}
                          className="transition-transform active:scale-90 hover:scale-110 cursor-pointer focus:outline-none"
                        >
                          <Star
                            className={`w-8 h-8 transition-colors ${
                              star <= (value ?? 5)
                                ? "fill-gold-500 text-gold-500"
                                : "text-stone-700 hover:text-stone-500"
                            }`}
                          />
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                />
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="space-y-1.5 text-right">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-stone-300">
                متن دیدگاه <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <textarea
                rows={3}
                {...register("commentText")}
                className={`w-full bg-stone-950 border focus:ring-1 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm text-stone-100 outline-none transition-all resize-none text-right leading-relaxed ${
                  errors.commentText
                    ? "border-destructive/60 focus:border-destructive focus:ring-destructive/30"
                    : "border-stone-800 focus:border-gold-500 focus:ring-gold-500"
                }`}
                placeholder="دیدگاه خود را اینجا یادداشت کنید..."
              />
              {errors.commentText && (
                <p className="text-[10px] text-destructive font-bold mt-1">
                  {errors.commentText.message}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>

            {commentError && (
              <div className="text-xs text-red-400 bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20 p-3 rounded-xl text-right">
                {commentError}
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="border-t border-stone-800 pt-4 mt-2 flex justify-end gap-2">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="ghost"
                onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
                className="text-stone-400 hover:text-stone-200 cursor-pointer"
              >
                انصراف
              </Button>
              <Button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="bg-gold-500 hover:bg-gold-600 text-stone-950 font-bold px-4 py-2 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
              >
                {isSubmitting ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                    در حال ثبت...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  "ارسال دیدگاه"
                )}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}


----------------------------------------------------------------

================================================================
PATH: ./src/components/CoffeeProductPage.tsx
================================================================

"use client";

import React from "react";
import { useCoffeeProduct } from "@/hooks/useCoffeeProduct";
import ProductVisuals from "./product/ProductVisuals";
import WeightSelector from "./product/WeightSelector";
import BlendSelector from "./product/BlendSelector";
import GrindSelector from "./product/GrindSelector";
import QuantitySelector from "./product/QuantitySelector";
import PriceSummary from "./product/PriceSummary";
import CheckoutDialog from "./CheckoutDialog";
import ProductTabsSection from "./ProductTabsSection";

interface CoffeeProductPageProps {
  initialProduct: any;
  initialComments: any[];
}

export default function CoffeeProductPage({
  initialProduct,
  initialComments,
}: CoffeeProductPageProps) {
  const {
    selectedWeight,
    setSelectedWeight,
    isCustomWeight,
    setIsCustomWeight,
    customWeightVal,
    setCustomWeightVal,
    selectedBlend,
    setSelectedBlend,
    selectedGrind,
    setSelectedGrind,
    quantity,
    setQuantity,
    isCheckoutOpen,
    setIsCheckoutOpen,
    blendProfile,
    computedWeight,
    priceMetrics,
    remainingStockCount,
    isOutOfStock,
    variantDetailsSnapshot,
  } = useCoffeeProduct(initialProduct);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-12" dir="rtl">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-10 items-start">
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-6">
          <ProductVisuals productName={initialProduct.name} />
        </div>

        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-8 lg:pl-2">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl lg:text-4xl font-black text-stone-100 tracking-tight mb-3">
              {initialProduct.name}
            </h1>
            <p className="text-sm text-stone-400 leading-relaxed max-w-2xl">
              {initialProduct.description}
            </p>
          </div>

          <WeightSelector
            selectedWeight={selectedWeight}
            setSelectedWeight={setSelectedWeight}
            isCustomWeight={isCustomWeight}
            setIsCustomWeight={setIsCustomWeight}
            customWeightVal={customWeightVal}
            setCustomWeightVal={setCustomWeightVal}
            setQuantity={setQuantity}
          />

          <BlendSelector
            selectedBlend={selectedBlend}
            setSelectedBlend={setSelectedBlend}
            blendProfile={blendProfile}
          />

          <GrindSelector
            selectedGrind={selectedGrind}
            setSelectedGrind={setSelectedGrind}
          />

          <QuantitySelector
            quantity={quantity}
            setQuantity={setQuantity}
            remainingStockCount={remainingStockCount}
          />

          <PriceSummary
            finalPrice={priceMetrics.finalPrice}
            isOutOfStock={isOutOfStock}
            onCheckout={() => setIsCheckoutOpen(true)}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <ProductTabsSection
        productId={initialProduct.id}
        description={initialProduct.description}
        initialComments={initialComments}
      />

      <CheckoutDialog
        isOpen={isCheckoutOpen}
        onOpenChange={setIsCheckoutOpen}
        activeVariant={{
          dbVariantId: "mock_variant_id",
          grind_type: variantDetailsSnapshot,
        }}
        selectedWeight={computedWeight}
        quantity={quantity}
        finalPrice={priceMetrics.finalPrice}
      />
    </div>
  );
}


----------------------------------------------------------------

================================================================
PATH: ./src/components/CheckoutDialog.tsx
================================================================

"use client";

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { ShoppingBag, ArrowLeft } from "lucide-react";
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion";
import { useForm, FormProvider } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "./ui/dialog";

import UserInfoStep from "./checkout/UserInfoStep";
import ShippingStep from "./checkout/ShippingStep";
import OtpStep from "./checkout/OtpStep";
import SuccessStep from "./checkout/SuccessStep";
import { checkoutSchema, CheckoutFormValues } from "./checkout/schema";
import { submitOrderAction } from "@/app/actions/order";

interface CheckoutDialogProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  activeVariant: any;
  selectedWeight: number;
  quantity: number;
  finalPrice: number;
}

type Step = "user_info" | "shipping" | "otp" | "success";

export default function CheckoutDialog({
  isOpen,
  onOpenChange,
  activeVariant,
  selectedWeight,
  quantity,
  finalPrice,
}: CheckoutDialogProps) {
  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>("user_info");

  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [fakeTrackingCode, setFakeTrackingCode] = useState("");

  const methods = useForm<CheckoutFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(checkoutSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      firstName: "",
      lastName: "",
      phone: "",
      shippingAddress: "",
      otp: "",
    },
    mode: "onTouched",
  });

  const { trigger, getValues, reset } = methods;

  const handleReset = () => {
    setStep("user_info");
    setErrorMessage(null);
    reset();
  };

  const handleNextToShipping = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const isValid = await trigger(["firstName", "lastName", "phone"]);
    if (isValid) {
      setErrorMessage(null);
      setStep("shipping");
    }
  };

  const handleNextToOtp = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const isValid = await trigger(["shippingAddress"]);
    if (isValid) {
      setErrorMessage(null);
      setStep("otp");
    }
  };

  const handleVerifyOtpAndSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const isValid = await trigger(["otp"]);
    if (!isValid) return;

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    const values = getValues();

    try {
      const result = await submitOrderAction({
        productId: "prod_coffee_bulk_01",
        weightGrams: selectedWeight,
        quantity: quantity,
        grindType: activeVariant.grind_type,
        finalPrice: finalPrice,
        customerName: `${values.firstName} ${values.lastName}`,
        customerPhone: values.phone,
        customerAddress: values.shippingAddress,
      });

      if (!result.success || !result.data) {
        throw new Error(result.error || "خطایی در ثبت نهایی سفارش رخ داد.");
      }

      setFakeTrackingCode(result.data.id);
      setStep("success");
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || "خطایی رخ داد. مجدداً تلاش فرمایید.");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={isOpen}
      onOpenChange={(open) => {
        onOpenChange(open);
        if (!open) {
          setTimeout(handleReset, 300);
        }
      }}
    >
      <DialogContent
        dir="rtl"
        className="max-w-md bg-stone-900 border border-stone-800 text-stone-100 p-0 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl text-right"
        showCloseButton={false}
      >
        <div className="p-6 pb-4 border-b border-stone-800/80 bg-stone-950/20 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-gold-500/10 border border-gold-500/20 text-gold-500 flex items-center justify-center">
              <ShoppingBag className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <DialogTitle className="text-base font-black text-stone-100">
                {step === "success"
                  ? "ثبت موفقیت‌آمیز سفارش"
                  : "ثبت نهایی سفارش خرید قهوه"}
              </DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription className="text-[11px] text-stone-400 mt-0.5">
                {step === "user_info" && "اطلاعات خریدار"}
                {step === "shipping" && "اطلاعات ارسال و پرداخت"}
                {step === "otp" && "تایید شماره تماس"}
                {step === "success" && "سفارش شما با موفقیت ثبت شد"}
              </DialogDescription>
            </div>
          </div>

          {step !== "user_info" && step !== "success" && (
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setErrorMessage(null);
                if (step === "shipping") setStep("user_info");
                if (step === "otp") setStep("shipping");
              }}
              className="text-stone-400 hover:text-stone-200 p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-stone-800/40 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="p-6">
          <FormProvider {...methods}>
            <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
              {step === "user_info" && (
                <motion.div
                  key="user_info"
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
                  exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
                  transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
                >
                  <UserInfoStep
                    onSubmit={handleNextToShipping}
                    finalPrice={finalPrice}
                    onClose={() => onOpenChange(false)}
                  />
                </motion.div>
              )}

              {step === "shipping" && (
                <motion.div
                  key="shipping"
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
                  exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
                  transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
                >
                  <ShippingStep
                    onSubmit={handleNextToOtp}
                    onBack={() => setStep("user_info")}
                    finalPrice={finalPrice}
                  />
                </motion.div>
              )}

              {step === "otp" && (
                <motion.div
                  key="otp"
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
                  exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
                  transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
                >
                  <OtpStep
                    phone={getValues("phone")}
                    onBack={() => setStep("shipping")}
                    onSubmit={handleVerifyOtpAndSubmit}
                    isSubmitting={isSubmitting}
                    finalPrice={finalPrice}
                  />
                </motion.div>
              )}

              {step === "success" && (
                <motion.div
                  key="success"
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
                  transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
                >
                  <SuccessStep
                    firstName={getValues("firstName")}
                    lastName={getValues("lastName")}
                    phone={getValues("phone")}
                    selectedWeight={selectedWeight}
                    quantity={quantity}
                    finalPrice={finalPrice}
                    trackingCode={fakeTrackingCode}
                    onClose={() => {
                      onOpenChange(false);
                      setTimeout(handleReset, 300);
                    }}
                  />
                </motion.div>
              )}
            </AnimatePresence>
          </FormProvider>

          {errorMessage &&
            step !== "user_info" &&
            step !== "shipping" &&
            step !== "otp" && (
              <div className="text-xs text-red-400 bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20 p-3 rounded-xl mt-4">
                {errorMessage}
              </div>
            )}
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

import * as React from "react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

function Card({
  className,
  size = "default",
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & { size?: "default" | "sm" }) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="card"
      data-size={size}
      className={cn(
        "group/card flex flex-col gap-4 overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-card py-4 text-sm text-card-foreground ring-1 ring-foreground/10 has-data-[slot=card-footer]:pb-0 has-[>img:first-child]:pt-0 data-[size=sm]:gap-3 data-[size=sm]:py-3 data-[size=sm]:has-data-[slot=card-footer]:pb-0 *:[img:first-child]:rounded-t-xl *:[img:last-child]:rounded-b-xl",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function CardHeader({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="card-header"
      className={cn(
        "group/card-header @container/card-header grid auto-rows-min items-start gap-1 rounded-t-xl px-4 group-data-[size=sm]/card:px-3 has-data-[slot=card-action]:grid-cols-[1fr_auto] has-data-[slot=card-description]:grid-rows-[auto_auto] [.border-b]:pb-4 group-data-[size=sm]/card:[.border-b]:pb-3",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function CardTitle({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="card-title"
      className={cn(
        "font-heading text-base leading-snug font-medium group-data-[size=sm]/card:text-sm",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function CardDescription({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="card-description"
      className={cn("text-sm text-muted-foreground", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function CardAction({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="card-action"
      className={cn(
        "col-start-2 row-span-2 row-start-1 self-start justify-self-end",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function CardContent({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="card-content"
      className={cn("px-4 group-data-[size=sm]/card:px-3", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function CardFooter({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="card-footer"
      className={cn(
        "flex items-center rounded-b-xl border-t bg-muted/50 p-4 group-data-[size=sm]/card:p-3",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

export {
  Card,
  CardHeader,
  CardFooter,
  CardTitle,
  CardAction,
  CardDescription,
  CardContent,
}

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority";
import { Tabs as TabsPrimitive } from "radix-ui";

import { cn } from "../../lib/utils";

function Tabs({
  className,
  orientation = "horizontal",
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof TabsPrimitive.Root>) {
  return (
    <TabsPrimitive.Root
      data-slot="tabs"
      data-orientation={orientation}
      className={cn(
        "group/tabs flex gap-2 data-[orientation=horizontal]:flex-col data-[orientation=vertical]:flex-row",
        className,
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

const tabsListVariants = cva(
  "group/tabs-list inline-flex w-fit items-center justify-center rounded-lg p-[3px] text-muted-foreground data-[orientation=horizontal]:h-10 data-[orientation=vertical]:h-fit data-[orientation=vertical]:flex-col data-[variant=line]:rounded-none",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "bg-muted",
        line: "gap-1 bg-transparent",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
    },
  },
);

function TabsList({
  className,
  variant = "default",
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof TabsPrimitive.List> &
  VariantProps<typeof tabsListVariants>) {
  return (
    <TabsPrimitive.List
      data-slot="tabs-list"
      data-variant={variant}
      className={cn(tabsListVariants({ variant }), className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

function TabsTrigger({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof TabsPrimitive.Trigger>) {
  return (
    <TabsPrimitive.Trigger
      data-slot="tabs-trigger"
      className={cn(
        "relative inline-flex h-[calc(100%-1px)] flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-transparent px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap text-foreground/60 transition-all data-[orientation=vertical]:w-full data-[orientation=vertical]:justify-start hover:text-foreground focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:outline-1 focus-visible:outline-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 dark:text-muted-foreground dark:hover:text-foreground group-data-[variant=default]/tabs-list:data-[state=active]:shadow-sm group-data-[variant=line]/tabs-list:data-[state=active]:shadow-none [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4",
        "group-data-[variant=line]/tabs-list:bg-transparent group-data-[variant=line]/tabs-list:data-[state=active]:bg-transparent dark:group-data-[variant=line]/tabs-list:data-[state=active]:border-transparent dark:group-data-[variant=line]/tabs-list:data-[state=active]:bg-transparent",
        "data-[state=active]:bg-background data-[state=active]:text-foreground dark:data-[state=active]:border-input dark:data-[state=active]:bg-input/30 dark:data-[state=active]:text-foreground",
        "after:absolute after:bg-foreground after:opacity-0 after:transition-opacity group-data-horizontal/tabs:after:inset-x-0 group-data-horizontal/tabs:after:bottom-[-5px] group-data-horizontal/tabs:after:h-0.5 group-data-vertical/tabs:after:inset-y-0 group-data-vertical/tabs:after:-right-1 group-data-vertical/tabs:after:w-0.5 group-data-[variant=line]/tabs-list:data-[state=active]:after:opacity-100",
        className,
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

function TabsContent({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof TabsPrimitive.Content>) {
  return (
    <TabsPrimitive.Content
      data-slot="tabs-content"
      className={cn("flex-1 text-sm outline-none", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

export { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent, tabsListVariants };

import * as React from "react"
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"
import { Slot } from "radix-ui"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const buttonVariants = cva(
  "group/button inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-transparent bg-clip-padding text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-all outline-none select-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 active:not-aria-[haspopup]:translate-y-px disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-3 aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:border-destructive/50 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/80",
        outline:
          "border-border bg-background hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground aria-expanded:bg-muted aria-expanded:text-foreground dark:border-input dark:bg-input/30 dark:hover:bg-input/50",
        secondary:
          "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-[color-mix(in_oklch,var(--secondary),var(--foreground)_5%)] aria-expanded:bg-secondary aria-expanded:text-secondary-foreground",
        ghost:
          "hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground aria-expanded:bg-muted aria-expanded:text-foreground dark:hover:bg-muted/50",
        destructive:
          "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/20 focus-visible:border-destructive/40 focus-visible:ring-destructive/20 dark:bg-destructive/20 dark:hover:bg-destructive/30 dark:focus-visible:ring-destructive/40",
        link: "text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline",
      },
      size: {
        default:
          "h-8 gap-1.5 px-2.5 has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-2 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-2",
        xs: "h-6 gap-1 rounded-[min(var(--radius-md),10px)] px-2 text-xs in-data-[slot=button-group]:rounded-lg has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-1.5 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-1.5 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3",
        sm: "h-7 gap-1 rounded-[min(var(--radius-md),12px)] px-2.5 text-[0.8rem] in-data-[slot=button-group]:rounded-lg has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-1.5 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-1.5 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3.5",
        lg: "h-9 gap-1.5 px-2.5 has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-2 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-2",
        icon: "size-8",
        "icon-xs":
          "size-6 rounded-[min(var(--radius-md),10px)] in-data-[slot=button-group]:rounded-lg [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3",
        "icon-sm":
          "size-7 rounded-[min(var(--radius-md),12px)] in-data-[slot=button-group]:rounded-lg",
        "icon-lg": "size-9",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
      size: "default",
    },
  }
)

function Button({
  className,
  variant = "default",
  size = "default",
  asChild = false,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"button"> &
  VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants> & {
    asChild?: boolean
  }) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot.Root : "button"

  return (
    <Comp
      data-slot="button"
      data-variant={variant}
      data-size={size}
      className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, className }))}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

export { Button, buttonVariants }

"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { Dialog as DialogPrimitive } from "radix-ui"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { XIcon } from "lucide-react"

function Dialog({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Root>) {
  return <DialogPrimitive.Root data-slot="dialog" {...props} />
}

function DialogTrigger({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Trigger>) {
  return <DialogPrimitive.Trigger data-slot="dialog-trigger" {...props} />
}

function DialogPortal({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Portal>) {
  return <DialogPrimitive.Portal data-slot="dialog-portal" {...props} />
}

function DialogClose({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Close>) {
  return <DialogPrimitive.Close data-slot="dialog-close" {...props} />
}

function DialogOverlay({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Overlay>) {
  return (
    <DialogPrimitive.Overlay
      data-slot="dialog-overlay"
      className={cn(
        "fixed inset-0 isolate z-50 bg-black/10 duration-100 supports-backdrop-filter:backdrop-blur-xs data-open:animate-in data-open:fade-in-0 data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function DialogContent({
  className,
  children,
  showCloseButton = true,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Content> & {
  showCloseButton?: boolean
}) {
  return (
    <DialogPortal>
      <DialogOverlay />
      <DialogPrimitive.Content
        data-slot="dialog-content"
        className={cn(
          "fixed top-1/2 left-1/2 z-50 grid w-full max-w-[calc(100%-2rem)] -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 gap-4 rounded-xl bg-popover p-4 text-sm text-popover-foreground ring-1 ring-foreground/10 duration-100 outline-none sm:max-w-sm data-open:animate-in data-open:fade-in-0 data-open:zoom-in-95 data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0 data-closed:zoom-out-95",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
        {showCloseButton && (
          <DialogPrimitive.Close data-slot="dialog-close" asChild>
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              className="absolute top-2 right-2"
              size="icon-sm"
            >
              <XIcon
              />
              <span className="sr-only">Close</span>
            </Button>
          </DialogPrimitive.Close>
        )}
      </DialogPrimitive.Content>
    </DialogPortal>
  )
}

function DialogHeader({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="dialog-header"
      className={cn("flex flex-col gap-2", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function DialogFooter({
  className,
  showCloseButton = false,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  showCloseButton?: boolean
}) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="dialog-footer"
      className={cn(
        "-mx-4 -mb-4 flex flex-col-reverse gap-2 rounded-b-xl border-t bg-muted/50 p-4 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
      {showCloseButton && (
        <DialogPrimitive.Close asChild>
          <Button variant="outline">Close</Button>
        </DialogPrimitive.Close>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

function DialogTitle({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Title>) {
  return (
    <DialogPrimitive.Title
      data-slot="dialog-title"
      className={cn(
        "font-heading text-base leading-none font-medium",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function DialogDescription({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Description>) {
  return (
    <DialogPrimitive.Description
      data-slot="dialog-description"
      className={cn(
        "text-sm text-muted-foreground *:[a]:underline *:[a]:underline-offset-3 *:[a]:hover:text-foreground",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

export {
  Dialog,
  DialogClose,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogOverlay,
  DialogPortal,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger,
}

================================================================
PATH: ./src/components/ui/badge.tsx

import * as React from "react"
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"
import { Slot } from "radix-ui"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const badgeVariants = cva(
  "group/badge inline-flex h-5 w-fit shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1 overflow-hidden rounded-4xl border border-transparent px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-all focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-1.5 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-1.5 aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 [&>svg]:pointer-events-none [&>svg]:size-3!",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "bg-primary text-primary-foreground [a]:hover:bg-primary/80",
        secondary:
          "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground [a]:hover:bg-secondary/80",
        destructive:
          "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive/20 dark:bg-destructive/20 dark:focus-visible:ring-destructive/40 [a]:hover:bg-destructive/20",
        outline:
          "border-border text-foreground [a]:hover:bg-muted [a]:hover:text-muted-foreground",
        ghost:
          "hover:bg-muted hover:text-muted-foreground dark:hover:bg-muted/50",
        link: "text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
    },
  }
)

function Badge({
  className,
  variant = "default",
  asChild = false,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"span"> &
  VariantProps<typeof badgeVariants> & { asChild?: boolean }) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot.Root : "span"

  return (
    <Comp
      data-slot="badge"
      data-variant={variant}
      className={cn(badgeVariants({ variant }), className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

export { Badge, badgeVariants }

================================================================
PATH: ./src/components/ui/slider.tsx
================================================================

"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { Slider as SliderPrimitive } from "radix-ui"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

function Slider({
  className,
  defaultValue,
  value,
  min = 0,
  max = 100,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof SliderPrimitive.Root>) {
  const _values = React.useMemo(
    () =>
      Array.isArray(value)
        ? value
        : Array.isArray(defaultValue)
          ? defaultValue
          : [min, max],
    [value, defaultValue, min, max]
  )

  return (
    <SliderPrimitive.Root
      data-slot="slider"
      defaultValue={defaultValue}
      value={value}
      min={min}
      max={max}
      className={cn(
        "relative flex w-full touch-none items-center select-none data-disabled:opacity-50 data-vertical:h-full data-vertical:min-h-40 data-vertical:w-auto data-vertical:flex-col",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      <SliderPrimitive.Track
        data-slot="slider-track"
        className="relative grow overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted data-horizontal:h-1 data-horizontal:w-full data-vertical:h-full data-vertical:w-1"
      >
        <SliderPrimitive.Range
          data-slot="slider-range"
          className="absolute bg-primary select-none data-horizontal:h-full data-vertical:w-full"
        />
      </SliderPrimitive.Track>
      {Array.from({ length: _values.length }, (_, index) => (
        <SliderPrimitive.Thumb
          data-slot="slider-thumb"
          key={index}
          className="relative block size-3 shrink-0 rounded-full border border-ring bg-white ring-ring/50 transition-[color,box-shadow] select-none after:absolute after:-inset-2 hover:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:outline-hidden active:ring-3 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50"
        />
      ))}
    </SliderPrimitive.Root>
  )
}

export { Slider }

================================================================
PATH: ./src/components/checkout/schema.ts
================================================================

import { z } from "zod";

export const checkoutSchema = z.object({
  firstName: z
    .string()
    .min(1, "لطفاً نام خود را وارد کنید")
    .min(2, "نام باید حداقل ۲ حرف باشد")
    .max(50, "نام بیش از حد طولانی است"),
  lastName: z
    .string()
    .min(1, "لطفاً نام خانوادگی خود را وارد کنید")
    .min(2, "نام خانوادگی باید حداقل ۲ حرف باشد")
    .max(50, "نام خانوادگی بیش از حد طولانی است"),
  phone: z
    .string()
    .regex(
      /^09[0-9]{9}$/,
      "لطفاً یک شماره موبایل معتبر (مانند ۰۹۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹) وارد کنید",
    ),
  shippingAddress: z
    .string()
    .min(1, "لطفاً آدرس تحویل را وارد کنید")
    .min(10, "لطفاً آدرس دقیق خود را (حداقل ۱۰ کاراکتر) وارد کنید")
    .max(500, "آدرس بیش از حد طولانی است"),
  otp: z
    .string()
    .length(4, "لطفاً کد تایید ۴ رقمی را به طور کامل وارد سازید")
    .regex(/^[0-9]+$/, "کد تایید فقط باید شامل اعداد باشد"),
});

export type CheckoutFormValues = z.infer<typeof checkoutSchema>;

import React from "react";

----------------------------------------------------------------

================================================================
PATH: ./src/components/checkout/OtpStep.tsx
================================================================

"use client";

import React, { useEffect, useState, useRef } from "react";
import { Smartphone, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { useFormContext } from "react-hook-form";
import { Button } from "../ui/button";
import { CheckoutFormValues } from "./schema";

interface OtpStepProps {
  phone: string;
  onBack: () => void;
  onSubmit: (e: React.FormEvent) => void;
  isSubmitting: boolean;
  finalPrice: number;
}

export default function OtpStep({
  phone,
  onBack,
  onSubmit,
  isSubmitting,
  finalPrice,
}: OtpStepProps) {
  const {
    setValue,
    formState: { errors },
  } = useFormContext<CheckoutFormValues>();

  const [otpDigits, setOtpDigits] = useState<string[]>(["", "", "", ""]);
  const otpInputsRef = useRef<(HTMLInputElement | null)[]>([]);

  const [timer, setTimer] = useState(120);
  const [isResendDisabled, setIsResendDisabled] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let interval: NodeJS.Timeout;
    if (timer > 0) {
      interval = setInterval(() => {
        setTimer((prev) => prev - 1);
      }, 1000);
    } else {
      setIsResendDisabled(false);
    }
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [timer]);

  const handleOtpChange = (value: string, index: number) => {
    const cleanValue = value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, "");
    if (!cleanValue) return;

    const newOtp = [...otpDigits];
    newOtp[index] = cleanValue.substring(cleanValue.length - 1);
    setOtpDigits(newOtp);

    const fullOtpString = newOtp.join("");
    setValue("otp", fullOtpString, { shouldValidate: true });

    if (index < 3) {
      otpInputsRef.current[index + 1]?.focus();
    }
  };

  const handleOtpKeyDown = (
    e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>,
    index: number,
  ) => {
    if (e.key === "Backspace") {
      const newOtp = [...otpDigits];
      if (otpDigits[index] === "") {
        if (index > 0) {
          newOtp[index - 1] = "";
          setOtpDigits(newOtp);
          setValue("otp", newOtp.join(""), { shouldValidate: true });
          otpInputsRef.current[index - 1]?.focus();
        }
      } else {
        newOtp[index] = "";
        setOtpDigits(newOtp);
        setValue("otp", newOtp.join(""), { shouldValidate: true });
      }
    }
  };

  const handleOtpPaste = (e: React.ClipboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const pastedData = e.clipboardData
      .getData("text")
      .replace(/[^0-9]/g, "")
      .substring(0, 4);
    if (pastedData.length === 4) {
      const digits = pastedData.split("");
      setOtpDigits(digits);
      setValue("otp", pastedData, { shouldValidate: true });
      otpInputsRef.current[3]?.focus();
    }
  };

  const handleResendCode = () => {
    const cleared = ["", "", "", ""];
    setOtpDigits(cleared);
    setValue("otp", "", { shouldValidate: true });
    setTimer(120);
    setIsResendDisabled(true);
    otpInputsRef.current[0]?.focus();
  };

  const formatTime = (seconds: number) => {
    const mins = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
    const secs = seconds % 60;
    return `${mins}:${secs < 10 ? "0" : ""}${secs}`;
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-5 text-right" dir="rtl">
      <div className="text-center space-y-2">
        <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-gold-500/10 border border-gold-500/20 text-gold-500 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-1">
          <Smartphone className="w-6 h-6" />
        </div>
        <p className="text-sm font-black text-stone-200">
          کد تایید را وارد کنید
        </p>
        <p className="text-[11px] text-stone-400 leading-relaxed max-w-xs mx-auto">
          یک پیامک تستی حاوی کد تایید برای شماره{" "}
          <span className="text-gold-400 font-bold tracking-wider" dir="ltr">
            {phone}
          </span>{" "}
          ارسال گردید.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="flex justify-center gap-3" dir="ltr">
        {otpDigits.map((digit, index) => (
          <input
            key={index}
            type="text"
            inputMode="numeric"
            pattern="[0-9]*"
            maxLength={1}
            value={digit}
            ref={(el) => {
              otpInputsRef.current[index] = el;
            }}
            onChange={(e) => handleOtpChange(e.target.value, index)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => handleOtpKeyDown(e, index)}
            onPaste={handleOtpPaste}
            className={`w-12 h-14 text-center text-xl font-black bg-stone-950 border-2 rounded-xl outline-none text-gold-400 transition-all shadow-inner ${
              errors.otp
                ? "border-destructive/60 focus:border-destructive focus:ring-destructive/30"
                : "border-stone-800/80 focus:border-gold-500 focus:ring-gold-500"
            }`}
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      {errors.otp && (
        <p className="text-[10px] text-destructive font-bold text-center mt-1">
          {errors.otp.message}
        </p>
      )}

      <div className="text-center">
        {timer > 0 ? (
          <span className="text-xs text-stone-500 font-medium">
            امکان ارسال مجدد کد در:{" "}
            <span className="text-stone-300 font-bold">
              {formatTime(timer)}
            </span>
          </span>
        ) : (
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={isResendDisabled}
            onClick={handleResendCode}
            className="text-xs text-gold-500 hover:text-gold-400 font-bold hover:underline cursor-pointer"
          >
            ارسال مجدد کد تایید
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="border-t border-stone-850 pt-4 mt-6 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="text-right">
          <span className="text-[10px] text-stone-500 block font-bold">
            پرداخت در محل:
          </span>
          <span className="text-sm font-black text-gold-500">
            {finalPrice.toLocaleString()} تومان
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="ghost"
            onClick={onBack}
            className="text-stone-400 hover:text-stone-200 cursor-pointer text-xs"
            disabled={isSubmitting}
          >
            ویرایش آدرس
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="submit"
            disabled={isSubmitting}
            className="bg-gold-500 hover:bg-gold-600 text-stone-950 font-bold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
          >
            {isSubmitting ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                درحال بررسی...
              </>
            ) : (
              "تایید نهایی و ثبت"
            )}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

"use client";

import React from "react";
import { Flame } from "lucide-react";

interface QuantitySelectorProps {
  quantity: number;
  setQuantity: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<number>>;
  remainingStockCount: number;
}

export default function QuantitySelector({
  quantity,
  setQuantity,
  remainingStockCount,
}: QuantitySelectorProps) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 p-5 bg-stone-900/30 rounded-2xl border border-stone-800/80">
      <div className="space-y-1">
        <span className="text-xs font-black text-stone-300 block">
          ۴. تعداد بسته‌های مورد نیاز:
        </span>
        {remainingStockCount > 0 && remainingStockCount <= 5 && (
          <span className="text-xs text-red-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Flame className="w-4 h-4 fill-red-500 text-red-500" /> تنها{" "}
            {remainingStockCount} بسته دیگر در انبار فرضی مانده!
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
        <button
          type="button"
          disabled={quantity <= 1}
          onClick={() => setQuantity((q) => q - 1)}
          className="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl bg-stone-950 border border-stone-800/80 hover:border-stone-700 hover:text-stone-100 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xl text-stone-300 disabled:opacity-35 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          -
        </button>
        <span className="w-12 text-center font-bold text-lg text-stone-100">
          {quantity}
        </span>
        <button
          type="button"
          disabled={quantity >= remainingStockCount}
          onClick={() => setQuantity((q) => q + 1)}
          className="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl bg-stone-950 border border-stone-800/80 hover:border-stone-700 hover:text-stone-100 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xl text-stone-300 disabled:opacity-35 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          +
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import React from "react";
import { ShoppingBag } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

interface PriceSummaryProps {
  finalPrice: number;
  isOutOfStock: boolean;
  onCheckout: () => void;
}

export default function PriceSummary({
  finalPrice,
  isOutOfStock,
  onCheckout,
}: PriceSummaryProps) {
  return (
    <div className="p-6 border border-stone-800 bg-stone-900/20 rounded-3xl space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <span className="text-sm font-bold text-stone-400">
          مبلغ قابل پرداخت نهایی:
        </span>
        <div className="text-left">
          <div className="text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-black text-gold-500">
            {finalPrice.toLocaleString()}{" "}
            <span className="text-sm font-bold text-stone-400">تومان</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Button
        onClick={() => !isOutOfStock && onCheckout()}
        disabled={isOutOfStock}
        className="w-full py-6 text-md font-bold rounded-2xl shadow-xl transition-all hover:scale-[1.005] active:scale-[0.99] bg-gold-500 hover:bg-gold-600 text-stone-950 cursor-pointer disabled:bg-stone-800 disabled:text-stone-500"
        variant={isOutOfStock ? "secondary" : "default"}
      >
        <ShoppingBag className="w-5 h-5 ml-2" />
        {isOutOfStock
          ? "موجودی انبار برای این وزن و تعداد کافی نیست"
          : "خرید آزمایشی و تسویه حساب"}
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}

PATH: ./src/components/product/WeightSelector.tsx
================================================================

"use client";

import React from "react";
import { Check } from "lucide-react";

interface WeightSelectorProps {
  selectedWeight: number;
  setSelectedWeight: (weight: number) => void;
  isCustomWeight: boolean;
  setIsCustomWeight: (custom: boolean) => void;
  customWeightVal: number;
  setCustomWeightVal: (val: number) => void;
  setQuantity: (q: number) => void;
}

const presetWeights = [
  { value: 250, label: "۲۵۰ گرم" },
  { value: 500, label: "۵۰۰ گرم" },
  { value: 1000, label: "۱ کیلوگرم" },
  { value: 2000, label: "۲ کیلوگرم" },
  { value: 5000, label: "۵ کیلوگرم" },
];

export default function WeightSelector({
  selectedWeight,
  setSelectedWeight,
  isCustomWeight,
  setIsCustomWeight,
  customWeightVal,
  setCustomWeightVal,
  setQuantity,
}: WeightSelectorProps) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3.5">
      <label className="text-sm font-black text-stone-300 flex items-center gap-2">
        <span className="w-5 h-5 rounded-md bg-gold-500/10 border border-gold-500/20 text-gold-500 flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-black">
          ۱
        </span>
        انتخاب وزن بسته‌بندی:
      </label>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2.5">
        {presetWeights.map((w) => (
          <button
            key={w.value}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setIsCustomWeight(false);
              setSelectedWeight(w.value);
              setQuantity(1);
            }}
            className={`px-5 py-3 rounded-xl border text-sm font-bold transition-all duration-150 flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer ${
              !isCustomWeight && selectedWeight === w.value
                ? "border-gold-500 bg-gold-500/10 text-gold-400 shadow-md"
                : "border-stone-800/80 bg-stone-900/30 hover:border-stone-700 text-stone-400 hover:text-stone-200"
            }`}
          >
            {w.label}
            {!isCustomWeight && selectedWeight === w.value && (
              <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-gold-500" />
            )}
          </button>
        ))}

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            setIsCustomWeight(true);
            setQuantity(1);
          }}
          className={`px-5 py-3 rounded-xl border text-sm font-bold transition-all duration-150 flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer ${
            isCustomWeight
              ? "border-gold-500 bg-gold-500/10 text-gold-400 shadow-md"
              : "border-stone-800/80 bg-stone-900/30 hover:border-stone-700 text-stone-400 hover:text-stone-200"
          }`}
        >
          اندازه دلخواه
          {isCustomWeight && <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-gold-500" />}
        </button>
      </div>

      {isCustomWeight && (
        <div className="mt-3 p-4 bg-stone-900/40 rounded-2xl border border-stone-800/80 space-y-2.5 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-1 duration-200">
          <label className="text-xs font-bold text-stone-400 block">
            وزن مورد نظر خود را به گرم (حداقل ۲۵۰ گرم) وارد کنید:
          </label>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <input
              type="text"
              inputMode="numeric"
              value={
                customWeightVal === 0
                  ? ""
                  : customWeightVal.toLocaleString("en-US")
              }
              onChange={(e) => {
                const cleanVal = e.target.value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, "");
                const numericVal = parseInt(cleanVal) || 0;
                const finalVal = Math.min(numericVal, 50000);
                setCustomWeightVal(finalVal);
              }}
              onBlur={() => {
                if (customWeightVal < 250) {
                  setCustomWeightVal(250);
                }
              }}
              className="bg-stone-950 border border-stone-800 focus:border-gold-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-gold-500 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-stone-100 outline-none w-32 text-center font-bold"
            />
            <span className="text-sm font-bold text-stone-300">گرم</span>
            <span className="text-xs text-stone-500 mr-auto">
              (معادل {(customWeightVal / 1000).toFixed(2)} کیلوگرم)
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export interface Product {

  description: string;
  stock_grams: number;

}

  last_name: string;
  rating: number | null;
  comment_text: string;
  created_at: string;
}

  first_name: string;
  last_name: string;

}

  grindType: string;

}

        id: "comm_1_reply",
        first_name: "پشتیبان",
        last_name: "کافه راز",
        rating: null,
        comment_text:
          "سلام جناب کریمی عزیز، خوشحالیم که کیفیت رست قهوه رضایت مشتریان ارزشمند شما را به همراه داشته است.",
        created_at: "2026-05-21T09:15:00.000Z",
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: "comm_2",
    productId: "prod_coffee_bulk_01",
    first_name: "مریم",
    last_name: "احمدی",
    rating: 4,
    comment_text:
      "عطر قهوه فوق‌العاده است. برای موکاپات روگازی آسیاب گرفتم و واقعاً طعم غلیظ و مناسبی داره. بسته‌بندی هم کاملاً پلمپ و مرتب بود.",
    created_at: "2026-05-18T11:20:00.000Z",
  },
];

export const MOCK_ORDERS: Order[] = [];

export function getProductWithPricing(id: string) {
  const product = MOCK_PRODUCTS.find((p) => p.id === id);
  if (!product) return null;

  const pricing = MOCK_PRICING_RULES.find((pr) => pr.productId === id);
  return {
    ...product,
    pricing: pricing
      ? {
          pricePerKgArabica: pricing.pricePerKgArabica,
          pricePerKgRobusta: pricing.pricePerKgRobusta,
        }
      : null,
  };
}

export function getCommentsByProductId(productId: string): Comment[] {
  return MOCK_COMMENTS.filter((c) => c.productId === productId);
}

export function addComment(
  productId: string,
  data: {
    first_name: string;
    last_name: string;
    rating: number | null;
    comment_text: string;
    parentId: string | null;
  },
): Comment | CommentReply {
  const newId = `comm_${Date.now()}`;
  const createdAt = new Date().toISOString();

  if (data.parentId) {
    const reply: CommentReply = {
      id: newId,
      first_name: data.first_name,
      last_name: data.last_name,
      rating: null,
      comment_text: data.comment_text,
      created_at: createdAt,
    };
    const parentComment = MOCK_COMMENTS.find((c) => c.id === data.parentId);
    if (parentComment) {
      if (!parentComment.replies) {
        parentComment.replies = [];
      }
      parentComment.replies.push(reply);
    }
    return reply;
  } else {
    const comment: Comment = {
      id: newId,
      productId,
      first_name: data.first_name,
      last_name: data.last_name,
      rating: data.rating,
      comment_text: data.comment_text,
      created_at: createdAt,
      replies: [],
    };
    MOCK_COMMENTS.unshift(comment);
    return comment;
  }
}

export function createOrder(
  data: Omit<Order, "id" | "createdAt" | "status">,
): Order {
  const newOrder: Order = {
    id: `ord_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11).toUpperCase()}`,
    ...data,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    status: "pending",
  };
  MOCK_ORDERS.unshift(newOrder);
  return newOrder;
}

export function getOrders(): Order[] {
  return MOCK_ORDERS;
}

import { clsx, type ClassValue } from "clsx";
import { twMerge } from "tailwind-merge";

// تابع استاندارد ترکیب کلاس‌های Tailwind برای کامپوننت‌های شادسی‌ان
export function cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]) {
  return twMerge(clsx(inputs));
}

  children,
}: Readonly<{

import CoffeeProductPage from "@/components/CoffeeProductPage";
import { getProductAction } from "@/app/actions/product";
import { getCommentsAction } from "@/app/actions/comment";

export default async function Page() {
  const productResult = await getProductAction("prod_coffee_bulk_01");
  const commentsResult = await getCommentsAction("prod_coffee_bulk_01");

  if (!productResult.success || !productResult.data) {
    return (
      <div className="text-center py-20 text-stone-400">
        {productResult.error || "محصول یافت نشد."}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-background text-foreground pb-20">
      <CoffeeProductPage
        initialProduct={productResult.data}
        initialComments={commentsResult.success ? commentsResult.data : []}
      />
    </main>
  );
}

================================================================
PATH: ./src/app/actions/order.ts

"use server";

import { createOrder, getOrders } from "@/lib/mock-db";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

export async function getOrdersAction() {
  try {
    const orders = getOrders();
    return { success: true, data: orders };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: "خطا در دریافت تاریخچه سفارش‌ها رخ داد." };
  }
}

export async function submitOrderAction(payload: {
  productId: string;
  weightGrams: number;
  quantity: number;
  grindType: string;
  finalPrice: number;
  customerName: string;
  customerPhone: string;
  customerAddress: string;
}) {
  try {
    const {
      productId,
      weightGrams,
      quantity,
      grindType,
      finalPrice,
      customerName,
      customerPhone,
      customerAddress,
    } = payload;

    if (
      !productId ||
      !weightGrams ||
      !quantity ||
      !grindType ||
      !finalPrice ||
      !customerName ||
      !customerPhone ||
      !customerAddress
    ) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: "اطلاعات ارسالی برای ثبت سفارش ناقص است.",
      };
    }

    const newOrder = createOrder({
      productId,
      weightGrams: Number(weightGrams),
      quantity: Number(quantity),
      grindType,
      finalPrice: Number(finalPrice),
      customerName,
      customerPhone,
      customerAddress,
    });

    revalidatePath("/");

    return {
      success: true,
      data: newOrder,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: "خطایی در فرآیند نهایی‌سازی سفارش رخ داد.",
    };
  }
}

================================================================
PATH: ./src/app/actions/product.ts
================================================================

"use server";

import { getProductWithPricing } from "@/lib/mock-db";

export async function getProductAction(productId: string) {
  try {
    if (!productId) {
      return { success: false, error: "شناسه محصول ارسال نشده است." };
    }

    const product = getProductWithPricing(productId);

    if (!product) {
      return { success: false, error: "محصول مورد نظر یافت نشد." };
    }

    return { success: true, data: product };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: "خطا در دریافت اطلاعات محصول رخ داد." };
  }
}


----------------------------------------------------------------

================================================================
PATH: ./src/app/actions/comment.ts
================================================================

"use server";

import { getCommentsByProductId, addComment } from "@/lib/mock-db";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

export async function getCommentsAction(productId: string) {
  try {
    if (!productId) {
      return { success: false, error: "شناسه محصول معتبر نیست." };
    }

    const comments = getCommentsByProductId(productId);
    return { success: true, data: comments };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: "خطا در بارگذاری دیدگاه‌ها رخ داد." };
  }
}

export async function submitCommentAction(payload: {
  productId: string;
  phone?: string | null;
  firstName: string;
  commentText: string;
  rating: number | null;
  parentId: string | null;
}) {
  try {
    const { productId, firstName, commentText, rating, parentId } = payload;

    if (!productId || !firstName || !commentText) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: "تکمیل تمامی فیلدهای ستاره‌دار الزامی است.",
      };
    }

    const newComment = addComment(productId, {
      first_name: firstName,
      last_name: "",
      rating,
      comment_text: commentText,
      parentId,
    });

    revalidatePath("/");

    return {
      success: true,
      message: "دیدگاه شما ثبت گردید و پس از بازبینی تایید خواهد شد.",
      data: newComment,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: "مشکلی در ذخیره دیدگاه شما وجود دارد." };
  }
}


----------------------------------------------------------------

================================================================
PATH: ./src/hooks/useCoffeeProduct.ts
================================================================

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";

interface ProductPricing {
  pricePerKgArabica: number;
  pricePerKgRobusta: number;
}

interface Product {
  pricing?: ProductPricing;
  stock_grams?: number;
}

export function useCoffeeProduct(initialProduct: Product) {
  const [selectedWeight, setSelectedWeight] = useState<number>(250);
  const [isCustomWeight, setIsCustomWeight] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [customWeightVal, setCustomWeightVal] = useState<number>(300);
  const [selectedBlend, setSelectedBlend] = useState<string>(
    "۵۰٪ روبوستا / ۵۰٪ عربیکا",
  );
  const [selectedGrind, setSelectedGrind] = useState<string>(
    "دانه کامل (آسیاب نشده)",
  );
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState<number>(1);
  const [isCheckoutOpen, setIsCheckoutOpen] = useState(false);

  const blendProfile = useMemo(() => {
    switch (selectedBlend) {
      case "۱۰۰٪ روبوستا":
        return {
          robusta: 100,
          arabica: 0,
          caffeine: 95,
          body: 95,
          aroma: 25,
          label: "کافئین فوق‌العاده بالا و خامه (کرما) ضخیم",
        };
      case "۷۰٪ روبوستا / ۳۰٪ عربیکا":
        return {
          robusta: 70,
          arabica: 30,
          caffeine: 80,
          body: 80,
          aroma: 45,
          label: "کافئین بالا، غلظت سنگین و تلخی جذاب",
        };
      case "۵۰٪ روبوستا / ۵۰٪ عربیکا":
        return {
          robusta: 50,
          arabica: 50,
          caffeine: 60,
          body: 60,
          aroma: 65,
          label: "بالانس عالی از عطر عربیکا و گیرایی روبوستا",
        };
      case "۳۰٪ روبوستا / ۷۰٪ عربیکا":
        return {
          robusta: 30,
          arabica: 70,
          caffeine: 45,
          body: 45,
          aroma: 80,
          label: "بسیار خوش‌عطر، ترشی ملایم و طعم یاد مرکباتی",
        };
      case "۱۰۰٪ عربیکا":
        return {
          robusta: 0,
          arabica: 100,
          caffeine: 25,
          body: 25,
          aroma: 98,
          label: "رایحه گلی بی‌نظیر، اسیدیته شفاف و طعم تخصصی",
        };
      default:
        return {
          robusta: 50,
          arabica: 50,
          caffeine: 60,
          body: 60,
          aroma: 65,
          label: "",
        };
    }
  }, [selectedBlend]);

  const computedWeight = useMemo(() => {
    return isCustomWeight ? customWeightVal : selectedWeight;
  }, [isCustomWeight, selectedWeight, customWeightVal]);

  const priceMetrics = useMemo(() => {
    const pricing = initialProduct.pricing || {
      pricePerKgArabica: 2200000,
      pricePerKgRobusta: 1800000,
    };

    const arabicaRatio = blendProfile.arabica / 100;
    const robustaRatio = blendProfile.robusta / 100;

    const pricePerKg =
      pricing.pricePerKgArabica * arabicaRatio +
      pricing.pricePerKgRobusta * robustaRatio;

    const pricePerGram = pricePerKg / 1000;
    const finalPrice = Math.round(pricePerGram * computedWeight * quantity);

    return { originalPrice: finalPrice, finalPrice };
  }, [initialProduct, blendProfile, computedWeight, quantity]);

  const remainingStockCount = useMemo(() => {
    return Math.floor((initialProduct.stock_grams || 150000) / computedWeight);
  }, [initialProduct.stock_grams, computedWeight]);

  const isOutOfStock = quantity > remainingStockCount;

  const variantDetailsSnapshot = useMemo(() => {
    return `ترکیب: ${selectedBlend} | آسیاب: ${selectedGrind}`;
  }, [selectedBlend, selectedGrind]);

  return {
    selectedWeight,
    setSelectedWeight,
    isCustomWeight,
    setIsCustomWeight,
    customWeightVal,
    setCustomWeightVal,
    selectedBlend,
    setSelectedBlend,
    selectedGrind,
    setSelectedGrind,
    quantity,
    setQuantity,
    isCheckoutOpen,
    setIsCheckoutOpen,
    blendProfile,
    computedWeight,
    priceMetrics,
    remainingStockCount,
    isOutOfStock,
    variantDetailsSnapshot,
  };
}
